meta.title: Aggregator salary field contradicts the body; body is primary

payload.requisition_text:
Jobsprint › Engineering › London
Software Engineer, ETL — Nordwick Data Ltd
London, UK (Hybrid) · Full-time · Entry level · £45,000
Posted 2 days ago · 87 applicants
[ Apply on Jobsprint ]

Software Engineer, ETL
Nordwick Data Ltd · Farringdon, London

Nordwick cleans and standardises property data for UK mortgage lenders. Our ETL platform ingests 300+ source formats; you'd build and harden connectors in Python.

About you: 0-2 years of experience, strong SQL, and the temperament to find missing commas in other people's CSVs genuinely satisfying.

Salary: £29,000 per annum. We are happy to sponsor Skilled Worker visas. 24 days holiday plus bank holidays, cycle-to-work scheme, Friday team lunch on the company.

expected.determining_fact: The posting body states £29,000, below the general threshold; the aggregator's £45,000 salary field contradicts the primary source and does not change what the employer is offering.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: We are happy to sponsor Skilled Worker visas

design_notes: Wrapper says £45,000, body says £29,000. Labelling convention 4: the body is primary. A solver that reads the structured-looking wrapper field passes salary and issues a false SPONSORABLE. The £45,000 string is present in the payload as bait by design.
